purpose: Official Razorpay Payroll context used only when Supabase retrieval is sparse for Payroll questions. This supplements, and does not replace, Supabase RAG.

sources.title: Razorpay Payroll
facts: Payroll supports employee lifecycle workflows from hiring through exit.
Attendance can sync into salary calculations so teams do not need to manually match attendance data to payroll computation.
Leave, attendance and holidays can be tracked and managed in Payroll.
Payroll supports HRMS integrations and reporting/analytics capabilities.

sources.title: RazorpayX Payroll HR Software
facts: The HR software experience covers onboarding to exit management, including full-and-final settlement.
Leave, attendance and reimbursements can be managed from the same dashboard.
Employees can use self-service for leaves, pay and tax-related tasks.

sources.title: RazorpayX Payroll Attendance Management
facts: Employees can mark attendance on the web and attendance can be regularised when corrections are needed.
Payroll can track attendance and shift timings and can integrate with biometric systems.
Attendance and leaves can be factored into employee salary calculations and salary disbursement.
Payroll automates operational statutory compliance work such as TDS, PF, PT and ESIC calculations/payments/filings within the supported scope.

sources.title: RazorpayX Payroll Plans
facts: Prime Plan is documented for 11-30 employees.
Elite Plan is documented for 31-1000 employees.
Enterprise Plan is documented for 1001+ employees.
Common plan capabilities include basic payroll functions, compliance payments/calculation/filing, advance payroll and time and attendance.

sources.title: RazorpayX Payroll Statutory Compliance
facts: Payroll automates operational parts of statutory compliance such as supported payments, calculations and filings.
Do not claim that every organisation-level statutory registration is handled automatically; scope varies by compliance and current product support.

qualification_guidance: First understand employee count because it affects plan fit and demo relevance.
Ask what is painful today: payroll calculation, attendance/leave inputs, compliance operations, salary disbursement, employee onboarding, reimbursements, reports, or full-and-final settlement.
Ask what the merchant uses today: spreadsheets, HRMS, another payroll provider, or a manual process.
Ask whether attendance comes from web, biometric devices, another HRMS, or manual sheets when attendance is a pain point.
For full-and-final needs, understand exit volume/frequency and whether the challenge is calculation, approvals, settlement tracking, or closure.
Do not force a generic demo. Prioritise only the modules that match the merchant's stated pain points.
demo_guidance: For a merchant with 120 employees and attendance plus full-and-final pain points, lead with Attendance and F&F / Employee Exit before generic modules.
For a merchant asking broadly what Payroll can do, explain the major capability areas first, then ask one concise qualification question.
When employee count is 31-1000 and the merchant asks which documented plan band applies, Elite is the documented plan band; do not invent pricing.
If the merchant asks for commercials or a price not present in verified retrieved context, say the commercial must be checked from the latest approved source.
